root_cause: Background correlation observes a smaller prefix while the complete-cohort fixture is still collecting reports; the test subsequently reads that earlier candidate snapshot.
fix: Use the existing database advisory lock across complete input collection in all five scope cases. Start a controlled in-flight correlation in the conflict case; catch its outcome immediately, release the lock, then await it on both success and failure.
limitation: This proves complete-cohort scope classification, not single-candidate or automatic-refresh behavior for production inputs arriving progressively.
